openwrt_wiki.Einleitung: modular mesh WiFi system powered by the Qualcomm IPQ4018 SoC; IEEE 802.11b/g/n and 802.11a/n/ac; v4.0 Bluetooth via an embedded Cambridge Silicon Radio, connected to an internal USB2.0 bus
openwrt_wiki.Opening the case: six (6) T6 torx screws; four (4) under the rubber feet on the base, two (2) underneath the plastic "grill" on the top; the top "grill" is clipped on and can be removed by pulling upwards; iFixit teardown https://www.ifixit.com/Teardown/Linksys+Velop+WHW01+Teardown/150164

openwrt_wiki.Installation: OEM Web installation (Forum-Guide 154931; Manual-Update-Seite der OEM-Oberfläche oder https://192.168.1.1/fwupdate.html); TFTP flashing über serielle Konsole (TFTP-Server 192.168.1.236, Datei nodes-jr.img, run flashimg / run flashimg2)
openwrt_wiki.Dual-Firmware: automatic recovery backed by a second set of partitions on the larger of the two SPI flash ICs; both primary and secondary must be flashed to prevent rollback to factory after 3 failed boot attempts
